correctness.rationale: For all star sizes m>=2 and w_i>0, the symmetric weighted Laplacian has simple eigenvalues when w_i distinct: the eigenvector leaf-to-hub ratio is w_i/(w_i-lambda). Evaluating its characteristic polynomial at w_i yields the exact horizon-free determinant ratio d_i², d_i=w_i^{m-1}/prod_{k!=i}|w_i-w_k|. Independent exact rational Krylov determinants confirm |det O_0|=(prod w_i)prod_{a<b}|w_a-w_b| and |det O_j|=(prod w_i)w_j^{m-1}prod_{a<b,a,b!=j}|w_a-w_b|. These polynomial formulas extend to coincident weights and prove only duplicated-pair leaves stay observable in exactly-one-pair case, while any triple or two-pairs make every Gramian singular. Strict factor comparisons exclude hub and lowest leaf; perturbing the pair at ranks r-1 and r yields positive log-ratio derivative and realizes each rank r>=2 as uniquely optimal. Symbolic construction, not finite random tests, supports all m and T.
residual_risks: Full-state finite T>0 ordinary determinant (not disagreement subspace, infinite-horizon Gramian or pseudodeterminant), symmetric star and direct one-coordinate sensor only.
